name: factoria
description: Plataforma desktop para criar e gerenciar bots de WhatsApp com IA

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
